spec.description: Cache-telemetry-only view; no Kubernetes metrics are used. Selectors and pod counts include only pods exposing local cache state metrics. Missing metrics cannot distinguish disabled cache, unavailable application, or scrape failure. Configured enabled/fallback mode and snapshot IDs are not exported by the current metrics. Counter rates are calculated before scrape deduplication. Local reads allowed is policy, not actual read traffic; fallback counters count attempts, including failures. No fixed grace-period alert threshold is assumed. Conditional pod counts sum boolean comparisons: zero means telemetry exists but no observed pods match; absent source telemetry remains No data.

spec.title: Observed cache pods
spec.description: Unique pods exposing cache state metrics. Not a complete pod inventory; disabled or unscraped caches cannot be identified.

spec.title: Cache status per pod
spec.description: Reported state: FRESH, STALE or UNINITIALIZED. Missing data is unknown, not disabled or FRESH. FRESH alone does not prove snapshot agreement between pods.

spec.title: Local reads allowed per pod
spec.description: 1 = local reads allowed by cache policy; 0 = local reads not allowed. A read can still fail and use fallback while policy is 1.

spec.title: Stale duration per pod
spec.description: Seconds since STALE, extrapolated from the latest scrape only while state is STALE. Grace duration is configured per application; no fixed threshold is shown. With fallback-mode none stale reads remain allowed indefinitely.

spec.expr: max by (pod) ((horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} + time() - timestamp(horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 1))

spec.title: Fallback attempts per pod
spec.description: Fallback attempts per second, including failures. Not a successful-delivery or successful-read counter.

spec.title: Subscriptions in active snapshot
spec.description: Active snapshot subscription counts. Different counts reveal different contents; identical counts do not prove identical snapshots.

spec.title: Snapshot mismatch per pod
spec.description: 1 = active snapshot differs from the known expected head; 0 = no mismatch reported OR expected head unknown. Zero does not prove freshness or cross-pod consistency.

spec.title: ZooKeeper disconnected
spec.description: Observed caches with a disconnected ZooKeeper client. No MongoDB head fallback exists; reconnection/reconciliation must confirm the authoritative ACTIVATED head. Conditional counts show 0 when source telemetry exists but no pods match; missing source telemetry remains No data.

spec.expr: sum((min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_zookeeper_connected{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 0))

spec.title: Cache failures (time range)
spec.description: Failures recorded under reason=activation, including snapshot load/activation failures and unusable ACTIVATED heads. Individual causes cannot be separated with the current counter.

spec.expr: sum(max by (namespace, pod, reason) (increase(horizon_local_subscription_cache_failures_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod", reason="activation"}[$__range])))

spec.title: Successful snapshot loads (time range)
spec.description: Successful MongoDB snapshot loads during the selected range. Failed loads are not counted here; see cache failures.

spec.title: Avg snapshot load time (time range)
spec.description: Average duration of successful snapshot loads from MongoDB in the selected time range. Empty if no snapshot was loaded.

spec.expr: sum(max by (namespace, pod) (increase(horizon_local_subscription_cache_snapshot_load_seconds_sum{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range]))) / sum(max by (namespace, pod) (increase(horizon_local_subscription_cache_snapshot_load_seconds_count{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__range])))

spec.title: FRESH
spec.description: Pods reporting FRESH. This status does not prove all pods use the same snapshot. Conditional counts show 0 when source telemetry exists but no pods match; missing source telemetry remains No data.

spec.expr: sum((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 2))

spec.title: ZooKeeper connection per pod
spec.description: 1 = client connected; 0 = disconnected. A connected client does not prove successful head reads or snapshot freshness.

spec.title: Cache failures per pod
spec.description: Recorded failures per interval. Current reason=activation includes load, activation and unusable ACTIVATED-head failures.

spec.title: Last snapshot load duration per pod
spec.description: Duration of the last successful snapshot load from MongoDB. Changes only when a new snapshot is loaded.

spec.title: STALE
spec.description: Pods reporting STALE. Local reads can remain allowed during the configured grace period, or indefinitely with fallback-mode none. Conditional counts show 0 when source telemetry exists but no pods match; missing source telemetry remains No data.

spec.expr: sum((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 1))

spec.title: Observed pods by cache state
spec.description: Counts of observed cache states only. No complete pod inventory, missing-cache detection or lifecycle filtering. Local reads not allowed is policy, not traffic. Conditional counts show 0 when source telemetry exists but no pods match; missing source telemetry remains No data.

spec.expr: sum((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 2))
sum((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 1))
sum(min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 0)
sum((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_local_reads{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 0))

spec.title: Fallback attempts/s by deployment
spec.description: Fallback attempts, including failures, aggregated by deployment derived from pod names.

spec.expr: sum by (deployment) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (rate(horizon_local_subscription_cache_fallback_reads_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{5,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

spec.title: Observed cache state per deployment
spec.description: Instant cache-telemetry counts per deployment derived from pod names. No lifecycle, readiness or restart information; pods without cache metrics are not included. Conditional counts show 0 when source telemetry exists but no pods match; missing source telemetry remains No data.

spec.expr: count by (deployment) (label_replace(min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{5,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

sum by (deployment) (label_replace((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 2), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{5,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

sum by (deployment) (label_replace((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 1), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{5,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

sum by (deployment) (label_replace((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 0), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{5,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

sum by (deployment) (label_replace((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_local_reads{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 0), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{5,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

max by (deployment) (label_replace(((horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} + time() - timestamp(horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 1)), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{5,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

sum by (deployment) (label_replace(max by (namespace, pod) (rate(horizon_local_subscription_cache_fallback_reads_total{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m])), "deployment", "$1", "pod", "(.+)-[a-z0-9]{5,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}"))

spec.title: Reported cache state per pod
spec.description: Reported cache state and read policy only. No startup/readiness inference. Missing telemetry cannot distinguish disabled caches from unavailable applications or scraping failures.

spec.expr: max by (pod) ((horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} + time() - timestamp(horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 1))

spec.title: Problem caches: STALE / UNINITIALIZED
spec.description: Observed cache pods reporting STALE or UNINITIALIZED. FRESH rows are excluded; pods with missing telemetry cannot be listed. No rows does not prove all pods are healthy.

spec.expr: max by (pod) ((horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} + time() - timestamp(horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 1))

spec.title: UNINITIALIZED
spec.description: Pods reporting cache state 0. Missing telemetry is not included or inferred as UNINITIALIZED. Conditional counts show 0 when source telemetry exists but no pods match; missing source telemetry remains No data.

spec.expr: sum(min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 0)

spec.title: Local reads not allowed
spec.description: Observed pods whose local-read policy is 0. This is not proof of successful fallback traffic or availability. Conditional counts show 0 when source telemetry exists but no pods match; missing source telemetry remains No data.

spec.expr: sum((min by (cluster, namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_local_reads{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 0))

spec.title: Behind expected head
spec.description: Unique pods whose active snapshot does not match the expected head: snapshot ID and document count are always compared, revision and source hash only when present on both heads; createdAt is ignored. Also 0 when no head is known - check STALE and UNKNOWN in that case. Conflicting scrape samples use the maximum per pod.

spec.title: Longest stale duration
spec.description: Longest STALE duration among observed caches. No fixed grace threshold: configuration may differ; fallback-mode none allows stale reads indefinitely.

spec.expr: max(((horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} + time() - timestamp(horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 1)))

spec.title: Fallback attempts/s
spec.description: Attempts delegated to the Hazelcast/MongoDB fallback, including failed attempts. Missing series is not converted to zero.

spec.title: Local cache per pod
spec.description: Latest available cache telemetry per pod, subject to scrape/lookback delays. Enabled, fallbackMode and snapshot IDs require additional metrics; snapshot details are available in /actuator/health when enabled and exposed.

spec.expr: max by (pod) ((horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} + time() - timestamp(horizon_local_subscription_cache_stale_seconds{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})) * on (namespace, pod) group_left() (min by (namespace, pod) (horizon_local_subscription_cache_state{cluster="$cluster", namespace="$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}) == bool 1))
